121076963.title: Blackout Basement
121076963.description:
A trip through the underground of a city to reach a train station for evacuation.
This campaign is base on the industrial side of Philadelphia, with the original survivors.

There are few optional crescendos in the campaign including light generators. Either play in the dark or light your way, with a small penalty of a crescendo.

This campaign includes four maps with quite a few, custom sounds, custom textures, and custom models.

121086524.title: Urban Flight
121086524.description:
The city is burning. As ash falls, the survivors attempt to flee to a small military airfield on the other side of the river. It's a straight path down the main boulevard, but nothing is ever simple. Crashed cars, blazing fires, police barricades, and the city itself all stand in their way.

[i]Urban Flight[/i] is a four-map campaign that features interesting environments, dynamic pathways, and a unique multi-stage finale. It supports singleplayer, co-op, versus, survival, and scavenge gameplay.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[b]TURN ON INSTRUCTOR HINTS![/b] This campaign uses the Instructor Hint system to explain important crescendo and finale event information. The Game Instructor can be enabled under Options > Multiplayer.

[h1]Scavenger Hunt[/h1]
To add an extra level of entertainment, the campaign features 10 minor easter eggs hidden throughout the environment. See if you can locate all of them. They are:

A pack of gnomes
A news-worthy drive-by
A gunshot suicide
A ridiculous notice
A cocaine habit
A shipment of beef
A floating upgrade
A BYOB workday
A spinning plate
A shipment of tank

But during a zombie apocalypse the least inhabitant places are the safest ones. So the places you previously avoided are going to become your asylum. Our heroes go out to the city to get to the police station where police forces were holding out. An evacuation centre was planned there. Through apartment houses and across the rooftops the survivors pass to a construction site where the severity of the situation will serve to teach them a lesson: God helps those who help themselves. 1540128972.title: Chernobyl: Chapter One
1540128972.description:
[h1]Hotfix v.1.0.6:[/h1]
- Fixed stringtable for first map

[h1]Hotfix v.1.0.5:[/h1]
- Adjusted difficulty level for all maps (now less spawns)
- Higher item spawn rate
- Random lockers now almost always spawn something
- Fixed some minor nav-mesh errors
- Improved performance slightly

[h1]Hotfix v.1.0.4:[/h1]
- Adjusted diffiulty level for finale (now easier)
- No more mobs on start of first map

[h1]Hotfix v.1.0.3:[/h1]
- lower spawn rates for special infected and mobs due to popular requests

[h1]Troubleshooting:[/h1]
[h1]General crashes[/h1]
-> Disable all other addons, especially those that alter models and textures
-> Update your graphics drivers
-> Fullscreen (not windowed)
-> Disable any secondary monitors

[h1]I have a purple checker box background[/h1]
-> Change your shader settings to „medium“ or higher

[h1]Lots of assets (models, textures) are missing[/h1]
-> Make sure you are subscribed to Chernobyl Content Part 1 - 7

[h1]My game crashes on starting the first map[/h1]
-> Make sure your addon list is updated completely before starting the campaign


[h1]The World in Shambles[/h1]
The infection continues to spread all over the Eurasian mainland, leaving its governments in disarray. With no other option in mind, the remaining survivors are heading east to reach the Siberian tundra. As rumor has it, the infection cannot spread effectively in the cold winds of the permafrost region.


[h1]A Flight gone wrong[/h1]
The four survivors managed to bribe one of the last pilots who is bound to leave Warsaw to fly them eastwards. The safest route seemed to be right over the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant as they thought there were no people left. Little did they know that prior to the outbreak there were still around 4000 people left to maintain reactor block #1 - #3 and seal off the destroyed reactor block #4.


[h1]Campaign Features:[/h1]
•	5 new maps in Coop (Versus included in the next update)
•	Close representation of the actual Jupiter Factory/Pripyat
•	Over 400 new models and 500 new textures
•	New “rescue vehicle”
•	Custom panic events


[h1]General Information:[/h1]
What you need to play:
•	Chernobyl: Chapter One
•	All 7 of the content addons
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1646203073]Chernobyl Campaign Collection[/url]


Please turn on the game instructor in your options for information relevant to progressing through the campaign.


Please turn on music for this campaign. Our composers have spent a lot of time and energy to create our very own soundtrack.


If you prefer Russian weapons, you can check out this collection of weapon/survivor mods. Of course, you can play with whatever mods you like.

[h1]A Flight gone wrong[/h1]
The four survivors managed to bribe one of the last pilots who is bound to leave Warsaw to fly them eastwards. The safest route seemed to be right over the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant as they thought there were no people left. Little did they know that prior to the outbreak there were still around 4000 people left to maintain reactor block #1 - #3 and seal off the destroyed reactor block #4.

[h1]The World in Shambles[/h1]
The infection continues to spread all over the Eurasian mainland, leaving its governments in disarray. With no other option in mind, the remaining survivors are heading east to reach the Siberian tundra. As rumor has it, the infection cannot spread effectively in the cold winds of the permafrost region.


[h1]A Flight gone wrong[/h1]
The four survivors managed to bribe one of the last pilots who is bound to leave Warsaw to fly them eastwards. The safest route seemed to be right over the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant as they thought there were no people left. Little did they know that prior to the outbreak there were still around 4000 people left to maintain reactor block #1 - #3 and seal off the destroyed reactor block #4.

180925247.title: Day Break (Campaign)
180925247.description:
It's been a long road since I started this project shortly before Left 4 Dead 2 came out, but I'm happy to share with you my custom campaign: [b]Day Break[/b]!

[h1]Campaign Description:[/h1]
The survivors must escape San Francisco before the military bombs it! After their helicopter crashes on the roof of Day Break Inn & Suites, the survivors must make their way out of the city, across the Golden Gate bridge, and hopping on a boat to Alcatraz for rescue.

The survivors pass by many real-world places and landmarks on their way.  While I have tried to be as true to the real San Francisco as possible, I have had to take some liberties with the area to make it suitable for Left 4 Dead 2 co-op and versus gameplay.  That being said, I have tried to be as detailed and accurate as possible when it comes to landmarks (which include [b]The Palace Of Fine Arts[/b], [b]Fort Point[/b], [b]The Golden Gate Bridge[/b], [b]The Lime Point Lighthouse[/b], and [b]Alcatraz Island[/b]) using all the resources available to me.

This is a five map campaign, designed and play-tested for [b]co-op[/b], [b]versus[/b], [b]survival[/b], and [b]scavenge[/b] game modes, and with a scavenge-style finale with a few added quirks.  

[b]NOTE:[/b] Turn instructor hints on for guidance on what to do during the panic events & finale. Additionally, if you have a photosensitivity or aversion to dramatically changing colors used in the easter eggs, try subscribing to this optional addon: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2499591827]Easter Egg Visuals Remover[/url].

[h1]Version 4 Update:[/h1]
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/180925247/3085508296754844826/]Version 4[/url] is now released[/b], bringing new content from the [b]Last Stand Update[/b], [b]new community content[/b], and many changes based on your feedback over the years! Feel free to leave more feedback in the comments & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/discussions/180925247]discussions section[/url], I make a point of reading each of your comments and replying when I can! Keeping your comments civil, descriptive, and constructive helps me the most in making this campaign the best that I can make it! 

If you have any technical difficulties with the campaign, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/180925247/3085508296754980288/]Troubleshooting FAQ[/url] to see if there is a known solution to your problem.

This campaign is also available on Gamemaps.com: http://www.gamemaps.com/details/9221

2274787444.description:
An underground military complex where the survivors were resting was overrun, the only way out is opening a path through the infected.
	 
[h1]Features:[/h1]
 1. 5 Long Maps (Not joking about this one)
 2. Heavy atmosphere for the most part
 3. Also heavy action for certain events
 4. Custom music (See bottom paragraph)
 5. References to movies, series or other games
 6. Le classic easter eggs
 7. Almost everything was made with vanilla assets.

[h1]Story:[/h1]
This campaign is set in an alternate timeline where the APC that rescues the survivors in Blood Harvest takes them to a vast underground Military Research Complex located somewhere beneath the wild mountains of West Virginia. In there, the survivors had 3 days of peace before the infected managed to break through the entire complex. Escaping from the initial invasion wave, the survivors managed to reach some maintenance rooms where they could hide until the outbreak calmed down, where the campaign starts.

[hr][/hr]
	 
This campaign is inspired by alot of things that influenced my level design skills for the past 12 years, this includes other campaigns such as Dark Wood and The Bloody Moors, so expect some heavy atmosphere maps but also some bursts of action in specific events. For a first run i recommend going in Easy or Normal difficulties first since i balanced the campaign for Normal. Advanced and Expert is untested by me, but it is totally doable with certain strategies and coordinated teamwork.
	 
Most of the custom music used comes from Hellgate London, except for the mega events of the third and fourth map, and the outro music, those respectively are:
[b]Elevator Event:[/b] (Bloodshot OST) Steve Jablonsky - The Tunnel
[b]Gates Event:[/b] (The Maze Runner Scorch Trials OST) John Paesano - Lights
[b]Outro:[/b] Nine Inch Nails - Only (Triptych remix by MoozE)
[b]Zombat:[/b] Two Steps From Hell - Norwegian Devil

[h1]WARNING! This campaign will test the skills you have with the game, it was made with gameplay experience in mind, and thus will heavily punish you for not controlling the hordes or not doing actual Team Work.[/h1]

2621559814.title: Buried Deep [2/2]
2621559814.description:
An underground military complex where the survivors were resting was overrun, the only way out is opening a path through the infected.
	 
[h1]Features:[/h1]
 1. 5 Long Maps (Not joking about this one)
 2. Heavy atmosphere for the most part
 3. Also heavy action for certain events
 4. Custom music (See bottom paragraph)
 5. References to movies, series or other games
 6. Le classic easter eggs
 7. Almost everything was made with vanilla assets.

[h1]Story:[/h1]
This campaign is set in an alternate timeline where the APC that rescues the survivors in Blood Harvest takes them to a vast underground Military Research Complex located somewhere beneath the wild mountains of West Virginia. In there, the survivors had 3 days of peace before the infected managed to break through the entire complex. Escaping from the initial invasion wave, the survivors managed to reach some maintenance rooms where they could hide until the outbreak calmed down, where the campaign starts.

[hr][/hr]
	 
This campaign is inspired by alot of things that influenced my level design skills for the past 12 years, this includes other campaigns such as Dark Wood and The Bloody Moors, so expect some heavy atmosphere maps but also some bursts of action in specific events. For a first run i recommend going in Easy or Normal difficulties first since i balanced the campaign for Normal. Advanced and Expert is untested by me, but it is totally doable with certain strategies and coordinated teamwork.
	 
Most of the custom music used comes from Hellgate London, except for the mega events of the third and fourth map, and the outro music, those respectively are:
[b]Elevator Event:[/b] (Bloodshot OST) Steve Jablonsky - The Tunnel
[b]Gates Event:[/b] (The Maze Runner Scorch Trials OST) John Paesano - Lights
[b]Outro:[/b] Nine Inch Nails - Only (Triptych remix by MoozE)
[b]Zombat:[/b] Two Steps From Hell - Norwegian Devil

[h1]ATTENTION! BOTH PARTS REQUIRED TO WORK![/h1]

◽ 第二关的难度取决于有多少真人玩家和游戏难度设置，如果机器人模组影响地图正常游玩请暂时禁用；
◽ 如果难度太高或太低，可选择适合自己的难度游玩。
◽ 坦克来了，离车远点，不要忘了你玩的是求生之路，车可以被坦克捶飞。

[h1]🔴已知Bug和缺陷： [/h1]
• 第一关因游戏引擎原因无反射球；
• 刚进入地图时第一次遇见普通感染者可能会顿挫，原因为游戏初次加载感染者模型；

• 因导航网格不完美部分特感会被载具卡住；
• 救援载具或许会抽风；

如果遇见bug和问题可尝试重开解决，同时欢迎反馈。
很高兴你玩我的地图，如果你玩的开心我会更开心。
[hr][/hr]

[h1]🔸If game crash, please disable some mods or disable all mods before playing.
🔸 Update version 1.4, if you encounter bugs welcome feedback in the comment. 
🔸 The map is currently the first chapter, will slowly make updates to subsequent chapters.[/h1]

[h1] Map filename: [/h1]
🟢unattainable_1	
🟢unattainable_2	

[h1] Game Tip: [/h1]
[h1] 🟥 Please enable the game hints when you playing, otherwise the map will not play properly. (Options - Multiplayer - Game Instructor) [/h1]
[h1] 🟥 If you are unable to pick up objects, please check if there are other mods or maps that affect the functionality of this map. Inability to pick up objects will prevent you from playing properly. [/h1]

3534785888.title: [V-Script] Intro Cinematic Fix (5+ Players)
3534785888.description:
[h1]⚠️THIS IS A FIX FOR SOURCEMOD SERVER HOSTERS WHO HOST 5+ PLAYERS![/h1]

[h2]What does this mod do?[/h2]
This mod fixes the intro cinematics that are tailored for four players only. This will ensure that all players, no matter how many, will be able to see the cutscene so they don't spawn in locked first person mode for the duration of the cutscene. Perfect for those who want to have their server be vanilla-like as possible.

[h2]Does this support every map or what?[/h2]
This is only supported on ALL vanilla maps.

[h2] Curious, why was it broken in the first place by any chance?[/h2]
The cameras for the intros run on point_viewcontrol_survivor. Since VALVE designed this game with only 4 players in mind, the cameras don't work above 4 players. Not to mention there's a finite amount of cameras. After searching through No Parking custom map, point_viewcontrol_multiplayer is the solution. To make this short, I created one camera and removed all viewcontrol_survivor cameras. Everyone is on one camera. The only thing I cannot bring back is that transition from cinematic to your player since that only belongs in viewcontrol_survivor.

384921079.title: The Hive (Part 1/6)
384921079.description:
Update: A serious issue that caused low-spec computers (or systems with low graphic settings configured in L4D2) to crash has been fixed. I hope this seriously improves your experience with this campaign

This is Part 1 of 6; this is the main part. Please download ALL parts to play the campaign! 

Note: If all the campaign parts highlight red and say conflicts with each other, this is not the case, it's just a glitch with l4d2 because the campaigns all share the same addon information so they can link, just ignore it!

If you wish to find out about recommended addons for this campaign, check out the gamemaps.com listing for this addon!

NOTE! To maintain the quality and preserve the atmosphere of this campaign, the L4D1 zombies are enforced inside the addon files. If you have ANY common infected mods on (such as one that turns all infected into Slender Men or zombies from Killing Floor) YOU MUST TURN THEM OFF. I understand that people may become slightly frustrated with it as the zombies don't have as much gore (you can behead them but not shoot limbs off), however I have made this decision as the campaign is based in North America and hillbilly zombies do not make sense or help the atmosphere; additionally, L4D2 removed all the varieties of zombies that look like they come from different professions; doctors, nurses, office workers, handy men etc. Sorry for any inconveniences!

NOTE: This campaign does NOT have any puzzles and I do not plan to put any puzzles in this campaign. It is not feasible to do so and would kill the pacing of the campaign and the purpose of it. Please understand this when you go to comment or leave a review

The Hive is a remake of the Hospital from 'Resident Evil: Nemesis', the 'Spencer Mansion' from GameCube's 'Resident Evil' and the entire 'Hive' from the 2002 Resident Evil movie, among other memorable locations. Players will get to explore their favourite RE locations in the triple remake of the Resident Evil universe. Built to mirror everything seen exactly as it was, no feature has been left out. Both the Hospital and the Hive have been linked seamlessly and seem to always have been the one. 

Descend 1 Mile underground to experience the fear of Claustrophobia and flesh eating infected combined. Visit 'Dining Hall B', disable the Red Queen, get spliced up by the lasers, find the T-Virus

Can you escape the hive?

About:

This music mod is a current work in progress which will compeltely replace the L4D2 sounds and soundtrack. The music has been crafted to fit the game perfectly bringing a whole new dynamic to L4D2. As time goes on more sounds will be replaced including those of the DLC

List of current sounds replaced:
